kasia: Legal: fine with range if CSV link and a one-line methodology (hardware parity, normalized per-token compute) are included. Also add EU routing + retention note.

jenni: Webinar Thu 2026-04-09 10:00 PT, cap 250, ops reserved 50 demo seats. Demand gen: enterprise priority window 36h, allocation 2 seats enterprise, 1 for others. Spell out in FAQ.

oliver: Ops: paste HubSpot mapping and I'll run the webhook dry-run.

sam: HubSpot snippet for the appendix: hubspot_form_id: hs_130099; properties: email->contact.email, company->contact.company, lead_tier->single_select(enterprise,startup,other); campaign: product_launch_apr2026; webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/hs/launch-final-2026

ops-bot: automated-check: webhook reachable, test payload accepted (200).
